title: Agent Pay and Visa TAP with VIC side by side
caption: Both networks use the same edge pattern (RFC 9421 signatures with a tag and a nonce, checked against a network-hosted key directory) and both issue their own agentic tokens. Tags, directories, token products and intent formats differ.
alt: Flowchart with two columns. Mastercard: tag Agent-pay-auth, Mastercard key directory (location not public), Mastercard Agentic Tokens, Verifiable Intent for intent. Visa: tags agent-browser-auth and agent-payer-auth, Visa key directory, Visa Intelligent Commerce agentic network tokens, TAP consumer and payment objects. Shared in the middle: RFC 9421, nonce, edge verification at Cloudflare, Stripe Shared Payment Tokens carry both tokens.
